checks.command: pytest -q tests/test_evaluation_distribution.py tests/test_evaluation.py tests/test_evaluation_envelope.py tests/test_evaluation_metrics.py tests/test_asr_subgroup_metrics.py tests/test_asr_evaluation_contract.py

supported_claims: Offline ASR reports can include pooled WER, consultation-level WER p50/p95 with type-7 quantiles, failure counts and worst labeled slices.
Role, noise and uncertainty slice data are included when manifest labels exist; unlabeled values remain visible.
limitations: Quantiles summarize the supplied development cases and do not imply independent clinical acceptance.
Slice labels depend on available manifest metadata; missing annotations are reported as unlabeled.
